home.title: Plan the session. Show the drill.
home.subtitle: Tell it who you coach and what went wrong last week. Get a timed session built from drills with animations, save the ones you like and share them with a link.
home.f1Text: Age, players, space and kit in. A warm-up, drills, a game and a cool-down out, with every check shown.
home.f2Text: Every practice plays as an animation. Pause, step through it and slow it down on the pitch.
home.f3Text: Save practices to your library and send them to another coach with a link.
home.honesty: Drills are drafts until a named coach has reviewed them. Anything written by the assistant is labelled AI draft.

legal.draftNotice: Draft, to be reviewed by a lawyer before launch.
privacy: Coach Me helps football coaches plan sessions. It is meant for adults who coach.
We store your email address, your language, your saved practices, your sessions and the links you share.
We do not collect personal data about players. Please do not write names, health information or other details about individual children in your notes.
Texts you type are sent to an AI provider to produce drafts. We do not use them for anything else.
You can ask us to delete your account and everything in it.
terms: Drills and sessions are suggestions. The coach decides what to use and is responsible for the safety of the session.
Content marked as pending or AI draft has not been reviewed by a qualified coach.
Do not use the app for medical, injury or diet advice about a child.
Shared links are visible to anyone who has them. Stop sharing to remove access.
